anacorp-ana-corp:lever:b41a24e7-ca2b-46b.title: Senior Cloud/IoT Applications Engineer
anacorp-ana-corp:lever:b41a24e7-ca2b-46b.description: About ANA: Join a recognized industry leader - Alliance North America was proudly named a 2025 Top Workplace in the Manufacturing Industry, an honor based entirely on feedback from our own employees about our culture, values, and workplace experience. Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, and ANA’s patented EBOSS® Hybrid Energy System and Smart load bank system. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment. ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada with locations in Cypress, California and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is growing and scaling and we are seeking an Senior Cloud/IoT Applications Engineer in an onsite position at Henderson, Nevada. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain the cloud and telematics applications that power our distributed energy fleet management platform, working day to day within an Agile team. The position is fully onsite, and the work schedule is weekdays from 8:00 AM-5:00 PM. This role reports to the Director of Software Development.
responsibilities: Stakeholder and Team Collaboration:
Coordinate with the Director of Software Development, Product Management, Customer Support, and customers to understand requirements, priorities, and feedback for cloud/IOT software.
Participate actively in sprint planning, backlog grooming, stand-ups, and retrospectives as a member of the Cloud/IoT software team.
Collaborate with the software team to ensure smooth integration between edge devices and cloud services.
Work closely with the QA/DevOps engineer and the software team to build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting automated testing, builds, and deployments.
Coordinate with the external development partners to evaluate and integrate cloud software.
Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality, consistency, and adherence to architectural standards.
Mentor and guide junior engineers, providing technical leadership and support.
System Maintenance and Compliance:
Monitor system health, performance, and availability of cloud and telematics services.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across cloud services and telematics data pipelines.
Support patching, upgrades, and lifecycle maintenance of cloud infrastructure and dependencies.
Perform database maintenance, including data integrity checks, backups, and performance tuning for AWS RDS and other data stores.
Create and maintain technical documentation for application designs, APIs, and test procedures.
Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices in cloud and application security, including SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001.
Support periodic penetration testing and remediate identified vulnerabilities in cloud applications and services.
Support integration and maintenance of customer facing APIs.
Cloud & Telematics Application Development:
Work with external resources to design, develop, and maintain cloud and telematics software for new and existing products using Python, AWS, TypeScript, CSS, and HTML.
Build and maintain cloud services and data pipelines (e.g., S3, DynamoDB, Lambda) supporting fleet telematics and remote monitoring.
Implement telematics data ingestion and northbound connectivity using MQTT and TCP/IP.
Design and implement RESTful and event-driven APIs supporting fleet management and telematics use cases.
Ensure seamless integration between cloud services, telematics data, and edge/embedded devices.
System Integration & Testing:
Partner with the QA/DevOps engineer to define test coverage, release gates, and deployment strategies (e.g., blue/green, canary) for cloud services.
Conduct end-to-end software testing and integration using PyTest, Playwright, GitHub, and YAML.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and automated regression tests to validate application performance and reliability.
Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment issues in collaboration with the QA/DevOps engineer to minimize release friction.
Continuous Improvement:
Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in cloud architecture, IoT connectivity, and telematics.
Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes, tooling, and Agile practices.
Other duties as assigned
qualifications: Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on cloud application engineering.
Proficient with Docker, Python, TypeScript and React for cloud and application development.
Proficient with AWS services including S3, DynamoDB, RDS, IOT/Core, Lambda, and API Gateway.
Proficient designing and consuming RESTful and/or event-driven APIs.
Proficient with data pipelines and asynchronous processing patterns (e.g., queue/job-based architectures).
Proficient with automated testing frameworks such as PyTest and Playwright.
Proficient with SCM tools and methodologies including Git, GitHub, and CI/CD.
Familiar with network protocols such as MQTT and TCP/IP for IoT and telematics data ingestion.
Experience collaborating with external development partners or outsourced engineering teams on shared codebases.
Proficient with software development and debugging tools such as VS Code.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally within an Agile team.
Preferred Qualifications:
AWS Certified Solutions Architect or similar
Experience with fleet telematics, ISO/TS 15143-3, or similar equipment telematics standards.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or AWS CDK.
Familiarity with OAuth 2.0 and modern authentication/authorization patterns.
Experience working alongside embedded/edge engineering teams on cloud-to-edge integration.
Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, or similar compliance frameworks.
Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:561c1444-8e1a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Director of Commercial and Legal Affairs based in United States. This is a senior in-house legal leadership role focused on commercial, privacy, and product matters within a fast-growing technology environment. You will lead complex enterprise SaaS and strategic partnership transactions while serving as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders. The role combines sophisticated commercial contracting with global privacy, data protection, AI, and product counseling. You will partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Security, Compliance, Finance, and other cross-functional teams. A key focus will be building scalable legal processes, playbooks, and technology-enabled workflows that support business growth. You will also lead, mentor, and develop legal professionals while helping shape a pragmatic, high-performing legal function. Partner with Security, Compliance, Product, and Engineering teams to identify privacy risks and embed appropriate data protection practices into products, processes, and commercial arrangements. Serve as a senior legal advisor to Product and Engineering throughout the product lifecycle, including product design, development, launch, data use, intellectual property, open-source software, AI, machine learning, and emerging regulatory considerations. Advise on the legal, commercial, privacy, and contractual implications of AI-powered products and workloads while helping teams adopt AI responsibly and efficiently. Develop and continuously improve legal playbooks, templates, policies, negotiation frameworks, and scalable contracting processes. Use AI-enabled legal and contracting tools to improve speed, consistency, quality, and operational efficiency while maintaining appropriate legal controls. Partner with Legal Operations to enhance workflows, technology, reporting, and processes supporting commercial and privacy activities. Monitor developments affecting cloud services, SaaS, technology transactions, privacy, AI, and related regulatory areas and translate them into practical business guidance. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5e173f51-bc27-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Operations Manager based in Italy. As Business Operations Manager, you’ll play a central role in ensuring commercial operations run smoothly across the EMEA region. You’ll act as the operational bridge between Commercial, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, HQ Operations, and external partners. Your scope will span the full commercial lifecycle, from quotations and orders through provisioning, invoicing, renewals, and partner operations. This is an independent, hands-on role where you’ll own issues, coordinate stakeholders, and drive solutions rather than simply provide administrative support. You’ll help identify operational bottlenecks and turn recurring challenges into scalable, standardized processes. Working in a fast-growing healthcare technology environment, you’ll have meaningful exposure to international markets and cross-functional initiatives. The role offers an opportunity to make a tangible impact on operational efficiency while helping support continued expansion across EMEA. Manage quotations and orders by preparing quotes and order forms, reviewing purchase orders, coordinating approvals, and ensuring accurate handovers between Commercial and operational teams. Coordinate order processing and license provisioning, ensuring customer and partner information is complete and resolving operational blockers efficiently. Support invoicing and accounts receivable activities by ensuring invoice readiness, coordinating with Finance, monitoring invoice status and overdue receivables, and resolving billing or documentation issues. Manage renewal operations by maintaining visibility of upcoming renewals, coordinating preparation across relevant teams and partners, and proactively tracking risks and outstanding actions. Support distributor and commercial partner operations, including onboarding, documentation, system access, internal setup, and alignment with operational processes. Coordinate operational requirements for new EMEA markets, working across Commercial, Legal, Finance, Regulatory, Customer Success, and HQ teams. Take ownership of day-to-day commercial operational issues by establishing clear owners and deadlines, coordinating stakeholders, removing bottlenecks, and driving matters through to resolution. Identify recurring operational challenges and develop scalable processes that improve turnaround times, reduce rework, and minimize unnecessary escalations to senior management. Monitor operational performance through metrics such as order-processing times, provisioning lead times, renewal readiness, partner onboarding, AR follow-up, and completion of agreed actions. Requirements: Approximately 4–7 years of experience in Business Operations, Commercial Operations, Order Management, or a related operational role. Experience supporting B2B commercial operations, preferably across multiple countries or international markets. Strong understanding of quotations, purchase orders, invoicing, renewals, and order-to-cash processes. Proven ability to coordinate effectively across Commercial, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Operations, and external stakeholders. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and reliable follow-through. Comfortable working independently and taking initiative in a fast-growing, evolving environment where processes may still be developing. Experience using CRM platforms and other business systems to manage operational workflows and information. Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders across different functions and geographies. Experience in SaaS, healthcare, medical devices, healthcare IT, or another technology-driven environment is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn operational issues into practical, repeatable solutions. Benefits: Full-time

jobgether-jobgether:lever:9a8b8abe-6329-.title: Senior Project Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:9a8b8abe-6329-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Project Manager based in Brazil. As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead complex, high-impact projects from initiation through successful delivery, balancing quality, timelines, costs, and client expectations. You will take full ownership of project execution and financial performance while driving continuous improvement across processes and workflows. The role combines strategic planning, operational leadership, client management, and team coordination in a global, fast-paced environment. You will work closely with enterprise customers, internal specialists, external partners, and localization teams to deliver outstanding outcomes. Strong risk management, communication, and problem-solving skills will be essential as you navigate changing priorities and escalations. This is an opportunity to influence how projects are delivered while building lasting client relationships and improving operational efficiency. Lead complex projects end-to-end, applying strong project management practices to ensure high-quality, timely, and cost-effective delivery. Manage client expectations by establishing realistic agreements aligned with project requirements, feasibility, timelines, and available resources. Own project financial performance, including budgets, invoicing, vendor selection, payments, profitability, and ongoing financial monitoring. Plan project activities, establish effective workflows, and implement best practices that improve delivery quality and operational efficiency. Drive continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to optimize processes, project structures, and ways of working. Lead and coordinate Localization Leads/Engineers while aligning the activities of internal teams, external partners, and other stakeholders. Maintain clear and consistent communication with enterprise clients and internal teams through meetings, presentations, written updates, and regular project reviews. Facilitate client and internal conference calls, ensuring decisions, actions, timelines, and responsibilities are clearly understood. Develop and maintain project documentation, process guides, and other materials required to support consistent execution. Conduct project risk assessments, develop mitigation strategies, and proactively address potential issues before they affect delivery. Manage escalations, perform root cause analysis, and develop corrective and preventive actions (RCA/CAPA) when required. Support strategic planning and ensure project activities remain aligned with business objectives and customer expectations. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Management, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable commercial experience. 5+ years of professional project management experience, including leadership of internal teams and direct communication with enterprise customers. Strong understanding of project management principles, methodologies, planning, risk management, financial control, and delivery optimization. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with clients, senior stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. Strong coordination, organizational, and time-management skills, with exceptional attention to detail. Proactive, solution-oriented approach with the ability to improvise, solve complex problems, and make sound decisions in changing circumstances. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality, timelines, profitability, and customer satisfaction. Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with a team-oriented mindset and the ability to lead and motivate project contributors. Comfortable working with global teams, external partners, and clients across different regions and working hours. PMI and/or Lean Six Sigma certification is considered

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f2622c89-804b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Comfortable working independently, taking ownership, and operating effectively within a small and agile team. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f991c3d2-eb7f-.title: Director of Marketing
jobgether-jobgether:lever:f991c3d2-eb7f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in Finland. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led business.
